story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번엔 생명이 숨 쉬는 순천만 상공이에요. 자연의 소리에 귀 기울여 보세요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon-en saeng-myeong-i sum swi-neun sun-cheon-man sang-gong-i-e-yo. ja-yeon-ui so-ri-e gwi gi-ul-yeo bo-se-yo.
story.en: Passengers, this time we're above Suncheon Bay, where life breathes. Please listen closely to the sounds of nature.

story.text: 저 넓은 초록빛 땅, '습지'예요. 물과 땅이 만나 다양한 생물이 어우러져 사는 소중한 자연이랍니다.
story.reading: jeo neolb-eun cho-rok-bit ttang, seup-ji-ye-yo. mul-gwa ttang-i man-na da-yang-han saeng-mul-i eo-u-reo-jyeo sa-neun so-jung-han ja-yeon-i-ram-ni-da.
story.en: That wide green land is a 'wetland'. It's precious nature where water and land meet, and diverse creatures live together in harmony.

story.text: 습지를 가득 채운 건 '갈대'예요. 가을이면 황금빛으로 물들어 바람 따라 물결처럼 흔들린답니다.
story.reading: seup-ji-reul ga-deuk chae-un geon gal-dae-ye-yo. ga-eul-i-myeon hwang-geum-bich-eu-ro mul-deul-eo ba-ram tta-ra mul-gyeol-cheo-reom heun-deul-lin-dam-ni-da.
story.en: What fills the wetland is 'reeds'. In autumn they turn golden and sway like waves following the wind.

story.text: 갈대숲 너머로는 촉촉한 '갯벌'이 펼쳐져요. 짱뚱어와 게들이 숨쉬며 살아가는 생명의 터전이에요.
story.reading: gal-dae-sup neo-meo-ro-neun chok-chok-han gaet-beol-i pyeol-chyeo-jyeo-yo. jjang-ttung-eo-wa ge-deul-i sum-swi-myeo sal-a-ga-neun saeng-myeong-ui teo-jeon-i-e-yo.
story.en: Beyond the reed field, a moist 'tidal flat' spreads out. It's a home of life where mudskippers and crabs breathe and live.

story.text: 이 넓은 습지에는 계절마다 '철새'가 날아와요. 먼 나라에서 쉬어 가는 소중한 손님들이지요.
story.reading: i neol-beun seup-ji-e-neun gye-jeol-ma-da cheol-sae-ga nal-a-wa-yo. meon na-ra-e-seo swi-eo ga-neun so-jung-han son-nim-deul-i-ji-yo.
story.en: 'Migratory birds' fly to this wide wetland with every season. They're precious guests resting on their way from faraway countries.

story.text: 겨울이면 귀한 손님, '흑두루미'가 찾아와요. 세계적으로 수가 적은 멸종위기 새라 순천만이 더욱 소중하답니다.
story.reading: gyeo-ul-i-myeon gwi-han son-nim, heuk-du-ru-mi-ga chaj-a-wa-yo. se-gye-jeog-eu-ro su-ga jeog-eun myeol-jong-wi-gi sae-ra sun-cheon-man-i deo-uk so-jung-ha-dam-ni-da.
story.en: In winter, a precious guest, the 'hooded crane', comes to visit. Since it's a globally rare, endangered bird, Suncheon Bay is even more precious.

story.text: 자, 생명이 가득한 다섯 단어를 만나 보았어요. 이제 문제를 풀며 자연을 다시 느껴봐요!
story.reading: ja, saeng-myeong-i ga-deuk-han da-seot dan-eo-reul man-na bo-a-sseo-yo. i-je mun-je-reul pul-myeo ja-yeon-eul da-si neu-kkyeo-bwa-yo!
story.en: Now, you've met five words full of life. Let's feel nature again by solving some questions!

words.example_en: Various creatures live in the wetland.
The reeds sway in the wind.
The hooded crane comes to visit in winter.
Crabs and clams live in the tidal flat.
Migratory birds fly across the sky.

sentences.en: A wetland is nature's treasure trove.
There's a walking path through the reed field.
The hooded crane is an endangered animal.
The tidal flat is home to mudskippers.
Migratory birds move with the seasons.
